subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's custom yielding bootstrap glob walker and internal hook scheduling as the compatibility-safe fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87509?
rationale: The patch has no concrete review finding and keeps the public SDK surface unchanged, but it intentionally replaces a runtime glob implementation and scheduling behavior on a compatibility-sensitive bootstrap path.

options.title: Accept after exact-head validation
options.body: Treat the remaining glob/runtime behavior delta as an intentional compatibility risk and proceed once the current merge head is validated.

options.title: Require more upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for an additional parity or live embedded-run proof before merge if maintainers want stronger confidence around existing bootstrap-extra-files configs.

options.title: Pause for a narrower replacement
options.body: Close or pause this branch only if maintainers prefer a smaller fix that does not replace the glob resolver.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Treat the remaining glob/runtime behavior delta as an intentional compatibility risk and proceed once the current merge head is validated.
